# API versioning

Breaking changes get a new major path prefix. Old majors stay for 6 months after the new one ships.

Owner: sre.
docs.title: API versioning

docs.body:
# Pagination

List endpoints return next_page tokens. Clients follow next_page until it is null and never guess page counts.

Owner: api-guild.
docs.title: Pagination

docs.body:
# Code review

Two approvals for changes to payment paths, one elsewhere. Authors do not merge their own change without review.

Owner: sre.
docs.title: Code review

# Error catalog overview

Every error code belongs to one domain page: errors-auth, errors-billing, errors-orders, errors-inventory and errors-platform. Check errors-amendments for later changes.

Codes are case-sensitive and always uppercase.

docs.body:
# Logging fields

Every service logs JSON lines with ts, level, service, trace_id and msg. Levels are debug, info, warn and error.

Owner: api-guild.
docs.title: Logging fields

docs.body:
# Metrics naming

Counters end in _total, durations in _seconds. Labels never carry user ids.

Owner: platform-team.
docs.title: Metrics naming

docs.body:
# On-call handbook

Primary on-call acknowledges pages within 5 minutes. Escalate to the secondary after 15 minutes without progress.

Owner: platform-team.
docs.title: On-call handbook

docs.body:
# Release calendar

Production releases run Monday to Thursday. Friday releases need an approved exception.

Owner: sre.
docs.title: Release calendar

docs.body:
# Feature flags

Flags live in the flag service. Remove a flag within two releases of reaching 100 percent.

Owner: sre.
docs.title: Feature flags

docs.body:
# Database migrations

Migrations are forward-only. Every migration ships with a rollback note in the change ticket.

Owner: api-guild.
docs.title: Database migrations

docs.body:
# Timeouts for batch jobs

Batch jobs set a deadline per item, not per batch. A job that exceeds its window is stopped and retried next window.

Owner: sre.
docs.title: Timeouts for batch jobs

docs.body:
# Cache policy

Read-through caches hold entries for at most 10 minutes. Writes invalidate, they never update in place.

Owner: api-guild.
docs.title: Cache policy

docs.body:
# Secrets handling

Secrets come from the vault sidecar. Never write a secret to a log line or an error message.

Owner: platform-team.
docs.title: Secrets handling
